items.html: *And behold, in the first Ibur of ZON, the VAK of BaN began to be clarified — they are the kings who died. And this is by the power that now the VAK of MaH came out and were mixed with them. And it is known that every edge (Kotz) is included of ten Sefirot. And behold, at first, at the time of the coupling, six Malchuts that are in the VAK of BaN were clarified.
